title: Michael Jackson and the Cost of Being the Product
audience: Readers who want a citable Psychonomics profile — catalog power, household as institution, and the dual ledger of genius and harm — not fan war.
metaDescription: A Psychonomics reading of Michael Jackson: Thriller-scale catalog economics, Neverland as household, and the cost of a self that became the entire product.
angle: Caesar = self as state. Beyoncé = self as firm. Jackson = self as product line — the person dissolves into catalog, spectacle, and a private household (Neverland) that the public was invited to mythologize. Quantify the catalog; map control; handle allegations with published legal outcomes and careful language.
